title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Boil salted water and cook spaghetti until al dente.
Fry pancetta or bacon in a pan until crispy.
Whisk eggs with grated Parmesan and black pepper.
Drain pasta, reserve some pasta water.
Off the heat, mix pasta with egg mixture and pancetta.
Add pasta water to loosen if needed. Serve immediately.

title: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Make dough with flour, yeast, water, salt.
Let dough rise for 1 hour.
Spread tomato sauce on rolled dough.
Add mozzarella and basil.
Bake at 250°C for 10-12 minutes.

title: Risotto ai Funghi
instructions: Sauté onion in butter until soft.
Add rice, toast for 2 minutes.
Add white wine, stir until absorbed.
Add hot stock ladle by ladle, stirring constantly.
Stir in mushrooms, Parmesan and butter. Season and serve.

title: Pasta Bolognese
instructions: Brown minced beef in olive oil.
Add chopped onion, carrot, celery and cook 5 min.
Add tomatoes, wine and simmer 40 minutes.
Cook pasta, toss with sauce. Top with Parmesan.

title: Tiramisu
instructions: Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale.
Fold in mascarpone.
Whip cream and fold in.
Dip ladyfingers in espresso, layer with cream mixture.
Dust with cocoa powder. Refrigerate 4 hours.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Brown beef in batches in a large pot.
Add onion, carrots, celery and cook 5 min.
Add flour, stock and potatoes.
Simmer covered for 1.5 hours until beef is tender.
Season and serve with crusty bread.

title: Fish and Chips
instructions: Make batter with flour, beer and salt.
Peel and cut potatoes into chips.
Fry chips at 160°C until soft, then at 190°C until golden.
Dip fish in batter and fry until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve with malt vinegar.

title: Shepherd's Pie
instructions: Brown minced lamb with onion and carrots.
Add stock and simmer 20 minutes.
Boil and mash potatoes with butter and milk.
Top lamb with mash and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes.

title: BBQ Ribs
instructions: Rub ribs with spice mix.
Wrap in foil and bake at 150°C for 2.5 hours.
Brush with BBQ sauce and grill for 10 minutes.
Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

title: Classic Burger
instructions: Mix minced beef with salt and pepper, form patties.
Grill or fry 4 minutes each side.
Toast buns on the grill.
Assemble with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese and sauces.

title: Mac and Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni until al dente.
Make roux with butter and flour.
Add milk and stir until thick.
Melt in cheese and season.
Mix with pasta and bake at 180°C for 20 minutes.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Mix flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
Whisk eggs with milk and melted butter.
Combine wet and dry ingredients.
Cook on buttered pan until bubbles form, flip.
Serve with maple syrup and butter.

title: Chicken Stir Fry
instructions: Slice chicken breast thinly.
Stir fry in hot wok with oil for 5 minutes.
Add vegetables and stir fry 3 more minutes.
Add soy sauce, oyster sauce and cornstarch mixture.
Serve over steamed rice.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Use cold cooked rice.
Fry eggs in wok and scramble.
Add rice and stir fry on high heat.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Add spring onions and serve.

title: Sweet and Sour Pork
instructions: Cut pork into chunks, coat in batter and deep fry.
Make sauce with vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, ketchup.
Stir fry peppers and pineapple.
Add sauce and bring to boil.
Toss pork in sauce and serve with rice.

title: Ramen
instructions: Simmer chicken stock with soy sauce and mirin.
Cook noodles separately.
Soft boil eggs for 7 minutes.
Arrange noodles in bowls, ladle hot broth over.
Top with chicken, egg, spring onions and nori.

title: Pad Thai
instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water 30 min.
Stir fry shrimp in hot oil.
Add eggs and scramble.
Add noodles and sauce (fish sauce, sugar, lime).
Top with peanuts, bean sprouts and lime.

title: Green Curry
instructions: Fry green curry paste in oil.
Add coconut milk and bring to simmer.
Add chicken and vegetables.
Season with fish sauce and sugar.
Serve with jasmine rice and basil.

title: Beef Bulgogi
instructions: Slice beef thinly and marinate in soy, sugar, garlic, sesame oil for 30 min.
Grill or pan fry in batches on high heat.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices overnight.
Grill chicken until slightly charred.
Make sauce with onions, tomatoes, cream and spices.
Add grilled chicken to sauce and simmer 15 min.
Serve with naan and rice.

title: Dal Makhani
instructions: Soak black lentils overnight, then pressure cook.
Fry onion, garlic, ginger with spices.
Add tomatoes and cook until mushy.
Add lentils and cream, simmer 30 minutes.
Serve with butter and naan.

title: Palak Paneer
instructions: Blanch spinach and blend to puree.
Fry paneer until golden.
Saute onion, garlic, spices.
Add spinach puree and cream.
Add paneer and simmer 10 minutes.

title: Biryani
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and biryani spices.
Parboil basmati rice.
Layer chicken and rice in heavy pot.
Cook on low heat (dum) for 30 minutes.
Garnish with fried onions and serve.

title: Tacos
instructions: Season and cook minced beef with onion and cumin.
Warm tortillas in dry pan.
Fill with beef, cheese, salsa and sour cream.
Top with lettuce and lime juice.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Mash ripe avocados with a fork.
Add lime juice, salt, and diced onion.
Mix in chopped tomatoes and coriander.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

title: Beef Burrito
instructions: Cook rice and season with cumin and lime.
Fry beef with taco seasoning.
Warm tortillas.
Layer rice, beef, beans, cheese and sour cream.
Roll tightly and grill briefly.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Slowly caramelize onions in butter for 40 minutes.
Add wine and beef stock, simmer 20 minutes.
Pour into oven-safe bowls.
Top with baguette slices and gruyere.
Grill until cheese is bubbling.

title: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Blind bake shortcrust pastry.
Fry bacon until crispy.
Whisk eggs with cream, season.
Add bacon to pastry case, pour egg mixture over.
Bake at 180°C for 30-35 minutes.

title: Crêpes
instructions: Blend flour, eggs, milk and melted butter.
Rest batter 30 minutes.
Cook in lightly buttered pan, swirling to coat.
Fill with your choice of sweet or savoury fillings.

title: Beef Bourguignon
instructions: Brown beef in batches.
Sauté bacon, onion and carrots.
Add red wine, stock, tomato and herbs.
Simmer 2-3 hours until beef is tender.
Add mushrooms last 30 minutes.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: Chop tomatoes, cucumber, and onion.
Add olives and feta cheese.
Dress with olive oil, oregano and salt.
Serve with crusty bread.

title: Moussaka
instructions: Fry eggplant slices until golden.
Make meat sauce with minced lamb and tomatoes.
Make béchamel sauce.
Layer eggplant, meat sauce, and béchamel.
Bake at 180°C for 45 minutes.

title: Hummus
instructions: Blend chickpeas with tahini, lemon juice, garlic and olive oil.
Season with salt and cumin.
Add cold water to achieve smooth consistency.
Serve drizzled with olive oil and paprika.

title: Paella
instructions: Heat oil in paella pan and fry chorizo.
Add onion, garlic, and peppers.
Add rice and coat in oil.
Add stock, saffron, tomatoes.
Add seafood and cook until rice absorbs all liquid.

title: Tortilla Española
instructions: Slowly fry potato slices in olive oil until tender.
Beat eggs with salt and mix with potatoes and onion.
Cook in oiled pan until set on bottom.
Flip carefully and cook other side.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Full English Breakfast
instructions: Grill bacon and sausages.
Fry eggs to your liking.
Grill tomatoes and mushrooms.
Toast bread.
Serve everything together with baked beans.

title: Eggs Benedict
instructions: Make hollandaise by whisking egg yolks with melted butter and lemon.
Poach eggs in simmering water with vinegar.
Toast English muffins.
Top with ham, poached egg and hollandaise.

title: Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast bread until golden.
Mash avocado with lime juice and salt.
Spread on toast.
Top with eggs, chilli flakes and seeds.

title: Minestrone
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, celery and carrots.
Add tomatoes, stock and beans.
Add pasta and cook until tender.
Add zucchini and spinach last 5 minutes.
Season and serve with Parmesan.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Roast tomatoes with garlic and olive oil at 200°C for 25 min.
Blend with stock until smooth.
Add cream and season.
Serve with crusty bread.

title: Pea and Ham Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter.
Add split peas and ham stock.
Simmer 45 minutes until peas are soft.
Blend until smooth.
Add diced ham and season.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic and cumin in oil.
Add lentils and vegetable stock.
Simmer 30 minutes until lentils are soft.
Blend partially for creamy texture.
Squeeze lemon and serve with bread.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Make dressing with garlic, lemon, Worcestershire, Parmesan and mayo.
Toss romaine lettuce with dressing.
Add croutons and shaved Parmesan.
Optionally top with grilled chicken.

title: Nicoise Salad
instructions: Boil eggs for 7 minutes, cool and halve.
Cook green beans until tender.
Arrange lettuce, tuna, eggs, olives, tomatoes.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon dressing.

title: Chocolate Lava Cake
instructions: Melt dark chocolate with butter.
Whisk eggs, egg yolks and sugar.
Fold in chocolate and flour.
Pour into buttered ramekins.
Bake at 200°C for 12 minutes. Center should be liquid.

title: Apple Crumble
instructions: Peel and slice apples, mix with sugar and cinnamon.
Make crumble with flour, butter and sugar.
Place apples in dish, top with crumble.
Bake at 180°C for 35-40 minutes until golden.
Serve with custard or ice cream.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Make base with crushed biscuits and butter.
Beat cream cheese with sugar and eggs.
Add vanilla and cream, mix until smooth.
Pour over base and bake at 160°C for 50 minutes.
Cool and refrigerate overnight.

title: Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter together.
Whisk in sugar and eggs.
Fold in flour and cocoa powder.
Pour into lined tin.
Bake at 180°C for 25 minutes. Cool before cutting.

title: Grilled Salmon
instructions: Season salmon with salt, pepper and lemon.
Heat grill to high.
Cook salmon 4 minutes each side.
Serve with lemon, dill and steamed vegetables.

title: Prawn Linguine
instructions: Cook linguine until al dente.
Fry garlic in olive oil until golden.
Add prawns and cook 3 minutes.
Toss pasta with prawns, chilli and parsley.
Squeeze lemon over and serve.

title: Fish Tacos
instructions: Season cod with cumin, paprika and salt.
Pan fry fish until cooked through.
Warm tortillas.
Assemble with fish, coleslaw and lime crema.
Top with avocado and cilantro.

title: Vegetable Curry
instructions: Fry onion, garlic and ginger.
Add curry paste or powder.
Add vegetables and coconut milk.
Simmer until vegetables are tender.
Serve with rice and naan.

title: Veggie Burger
instructions: Mix beans, breadcrumbs, egg, cumin and coriander.
Form into patties and refrigerate 30 min.
Pan fry patties until golden each side.
Serve in buns with lettuce, tomato and mayo.

title: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Sauté shallots and garlic in butter.
Toast arborio rice.
Add white wine then stock ladle by ladle.
Stir in mushrooms, Parmesan and butter.
Season with salt, pepper and thyme.

title: Shakshuka
instructions: Sauté onion and peppers in olive oil.
Add garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli.
Add crushed tomatoes, simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells and crack eggs into them.
Cover and cook until whites set. Serve with bread.

title: Falafel
instructions: Blend soaked chickpeas with garlic, parsley and spices.
Form into balls or patties.
Deep fry until golden and crispy.
Serve in pitta with hummus, salad and tahini.

title: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Season and grill chicken breast.
Make Caesar dressing with garlic, lemon, mayo.
Toss romaine with dressing.
Top with sliced chicken, croutons and Parmesan.

title: Chicken Soup
instructions: Simmer whole chicken in water with vegetables for 1 hour.
Remove chicken, shred meat.
Add noodles to broth and cook.
Return chicken to soup.
Season and serve hot.

title: Butter Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices.
Grill until slightly charred.
Make sauce with butter, tomatoes, cream and spices.
Add chicken to sauce and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with rice and naan.

title: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Slice chicken and peppers into strips.
Season with cumin, paprika and garlic.
Stir fry in hot pan until cooked.
Serve in warm tortillas with sour cream and salsa.

title: Pesto Pasta
instructions: Blend basil, pine nuts, garlic, Parmesan and olive oil.
Cook pasta until al dente.
Toss with pesto sauce.
Add cherry tomatoes and extra Parmesan.

title: Lasagne
instructions: Make Bolognese sauce with beef and tomatoes.
Make béchamel with butter, flour and milk.
Layer pasta sheets, Bolognese, béchamel and cheese.
Repeat layers and top with béchamel and cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 45 minutes.

title: Amatriciana
instructions: Fry guanciale or pancetta until crispy.
Add tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Cook rigatoni until al dente.
Toss pasta with sauce and Pecorino.
Season with black pepper.

title: Lamb Chops
instructions: Marinate chops with rosemary, garlic and olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Grill on high heat 4 minutes each side.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

title: Lamb Tagine
instructions: Brown lamb with onion and garlic.
Add spices: cumin, coriander, ginger, cinnamon.
Add tomatoes, chickpeas and dried apricots.
Simmer 1.5 hours until tender.
Serve with couscous and coriander.

title: Beef Tacos
instructions: Cook minced beef with onion and taco spices.
Warm corn tortillas.
Fill with beef, salsa and cheese.
Top with chopped cilantro and lime.

title: Chilli Con Carne
instructions: Brown minced beef with onion and garlic.
Add chilli powder, cumin, paprika.
Add tomatoes, beef stock and kidney beans.
Simmer 45 minutes.
Serve with rice, sour cream and cheese.

title: Pulled Pork
instructions: Rub pork shoulder with spice mix.
Cook in slow cooker on low for 8 hours.
Shred with forks.
Mix with BBQ sauce.
Serve in buns with coleslaw.

title: Korean Fried Chicken
instructions: Coat chicken in seasoned flour and cornstarch.
Double fry at 160°C then 190°C.
Make sauce with gochujang, soy, sugar, garlic.
Toss chicken in sauce.
Garnish with sesame seeds and spring onion.

title: Vietnamese Pho
instructions: Char onion and ginger, add to stock with spices.
Simmer beef stock for 3 hours.
Strain and season with fish sauce.
Serve with rice noodles, raw beef slices.
Accompany with bean sprouts, basil, lime and chilli.

title: Falafel Wrap
instructions: Warm pitta bread.
Spread with hummus.
Add falafel, lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber.
Drizzle with tahini and lemon.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
instructions: Mix soy sauce, mirin, sugar for teriyaki sauce.
Pan fry chicken until golden.
Add sauce and cook until glazed.
Serve over rice with sesame seeds and spring onions.

title: Miso Soup
instructions: Heat dashi stock.
Dissolve miso paste in stock.
Add tofu, wakame and spring onion.
Do not boil after adding miso.
Serve immediately.

title: Sushi Rolls
instructions: Cook sushi rice and season with rice vinegar.
Place nori on bamboo mat, spread rice.
Add filling (salmon, cucumber, avocado).
Roll tightly and slice with wet knife.
Serve with soy sauce, wasabi and pickled ginger.

title: Gyoza
instructions: Mix pork, cabbage, ginger, garlic and soy sauce.
Fill dumpling wrappers and pleat edges.
Fry in oil until golden on bottom.
Add water, cover and steam 5 minutes.
Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Beef Wellington
instructions: Sear beef fillet all over, let cool.
Coat with mushroom duxelles and Parma ham.
Wrap in puff pastry and refrigerate 30 min.
Brush with egg wash.
Bake at 220°C for 25 minutes for medium rare.

title: Chicken Parmigiana
instructions: Pound chicken breasts flat.
Coat in breadcrumbs and fry until golden.
Top with tomato sauce and mozzarella.
Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes.
Serve with pasta or salad.

title: Beef Rendang
instructions: Blend shallots, lemongrass, chillies, ginger, garlic.
Fry paste until fragrant.
Add beef and coat in paste.
Add coconut milk and simmer until almost dry.
Cook on low until beef is tender and dark.

title: Borscht
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic.
Add grated beets and carrots, cook 10 minutes.
Add cabbage and potato.
Pour in stock and simmer 30 minutes.
Season with vinegar and sugar. Serve with sour cream.

title: Pierogi
instructions: Make dough with flour, egg and water.
Fill with mashed potato and cheese.
Fold and seal edges.
Boil in salted water until they float.
Pan fry in butter until golden.
Serve with sour cream and fried onion.

title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente.
Fry sliced garlic in olive oil until golden.
Add chilli flakes and parsley.
Toss pasta with garlic oil and pasta water.
Serve with Parmesan.

title: Gnocchi al Pomodoro
instructions: Boil potatoes, peel and mash.
Mix with flour and egg to form dough.
Roll into ropes and cut into pieces.
Cook in boiling water until they float.
Serve with tomato sauce and basil.

title: Bruschetta
instructions: Toast thick slices of sourdough.
Rub with garlic clove.
Top with diced tomatoes, basil and olive oil.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Serve immediately.

title: Osso Buco
instructions: Dust veal shanks in flour and brown in butter.
Add onion, carrot, celery and cook 5 minutes.
Add white wine, tomatoes and stock.
Braise in oven at 160°C for 1.5 hours.
Make gremolata with lemon zest, garlic, parsley.
Serve with risotto Milanese and gremolata.

title: Cacio e Pepe
instructions: Cook tonnarelli or spaghetti al dente.
Toast coarsely ground black pepper in pan.
Add pasta water to create sauce.
Toss with Pecorino Romano off the heat.
Add more pasta water if needed for creaminess.

title: Chicken Marsala
instructions: Pound chicken breasts thin and dust in flour.
Fry in butter until golden each side.
Add mushrooms and cook 3 minutes.
Pour in Marsala wine and chicken stock.
Simmer until sauce thickens. Serve with pasta.

title: Polenta
instructions: Bring salted water to boil.
Whisk in polenta gradually.
Stir constantly for 30 minutes on low heat.
Remove from heat, stir in butter and Parmesan.
Serve topped with mushroom ragù or tomato sauce.

title: Chicken Piccata
instructions: Pound chicken thin, dust in flour.
Fry in olive oil until golden.
Add white wine, lemon juice and capers.
Simmer sauce and finish with butter.
Serve with pasta or mashed potato.

title: Roast Beef
instructions: Bring beef to room temperature, season generously.
Sear in hot pan all over.
Roast at 220°C for 20 min, then 160°C for 1 hour.
Rest 20 minutes before carving.
Make gravy from pan juices.

title: Bangers and Mash
instructions: Grill or fry sausages until cooked through.
Boil potatoes until tender.
Mash with butter, milk and seasoning.
Make onion gravy by caramelising onions.
Serve sausages on mash with gravy.

title: Cottage Pie
instructions: Brown minced beef with onion and carrots.
Add stock, Worcestershire and tomato purée.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Top with mashed potato.
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until golden.

title: Sticky Toffee Pudding
instructions: Make sponge with flour, sugar, eggs and dates.
Bake at 180°C for 25 minutes.
Make toffee sauce with butter, cream and sugar.
Pour warm sauce over hot pudding.
Serve with vanilla ice cream.

title: Welsh Rarebit
instructions: Make cheese sauce with cheddar, butter, flour, beer.
Season with mustard and Worcestershire sauce.
Toast bread.
Spread cheese mixture on toast.
Grill until bubbling and golden.

title: Chicken Tikka
instructions: Cut chicken into chunks.
Marinate in yogurt, lemon, cumin, coriander, turmeric.
Thread on skewers.
Grill on high heat turning every 3 minutes.
Serve with mint chutney and salad.

title: Saag Aloo
instructions: Fry cumin seeds in oil until sputtering.
Add diced potato and cook 10 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger and spices.
Add spinach and wilt.
Season and serve with rice or naan.

title: Aloo Gobi
instructions: Heat oil and fry cumin and mustard seeds.
Add onion, garlic and ginger, cook until soft.
Add potato and cauliflower.
Add spices and tomatoes, cook 20 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve.

title: Chicken Korma
instructions: Blend onion, ginger, garlic and cashews.
Fry paste in oil until golden.
Add chicken and cook 5 minutes.
Add yogurt, cream and spices.
Simmer 20 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Naan Bread
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, yogurt, salt and water.
Knead until smooth, let rise 1 hour.
Divide and roll into ovals.
Cook in very hot dry pan until charred.
Brush with butter and garlic.

title: Samosas
instructions: Make spiced potato and pea filling.
Make dough with flour, oil and water.
Fill and fold into triangles.
Deep fry until golden and crispy.
Serve with mint chutney.

title: Burritos Bowl
instructions: Cook seasoned rice.
Season and cook chicken with cumin and paprika.
Warm black beans.
Assemble bowls with rice, chicken, beans.
Top with avocado, salsa, cheese, sour cream.

title: Quesadillas
instructions: Spread cheese on half of tortilla.
Add peppers and onion.
Fold tortilla in half.
Cook in dry pan until golden each side.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Cook chicken and shred.
Fill tortillas with chicken and cheese, roll up.
Place in baking dish, cover with enchilada sauce.
Top with cheese and bake 25 minutes.
Serve with sour cream and guacamole.

title: Nachos
instructions: Spread tortilla chips on baking tray.
Top with beans, jalapenos and cheese.
Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until cheese melts.
Top with guacamole, sour cream and salsa.
Serve immediately.

title: Churros
instructions: Make dough with water, butter, flour.
Pipe into hot oil and fry until golden.
Drain and roll in cinnamon sugar.
Make chocolate dipping sauce.
Serve warm.

title: Gazpacho
instructions: Blend tomatoes, cucumber, peppers, garlic.
Add olive oil and vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper.
Chill for 2 hours.
Serve cold with croutons.

title: Bouillabaisse
instructions: Sauté onion, fennel and garlic in olive oil.
Add tomatoes, saffron and fish stock.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Add firm fish first, then delicate fish.
Serve with rouille and crusty bread.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Slice vegetables into thin rounds.
Layer zucchini, eggplant, tomatoes, peppers in dish.
Make tomato sauce base.
Cover with vegetables.
Bake at 160°C for 1 hour.

title: Croissant
instructions: Make enriched dough and rest overnight.
Laminate with butter in multiple folds.
Shape into crescents.
Proof 2 hours.
Brush with egg wash and bake at 200°C for 18 minutes.

title: Coq au Vin
instructions: Brown chicken pieces in butter.
Fry bacon, onion and mushrooms.
Add red wine and chicken stock.
Simmer covered for 1 hour.
Thicken sauce and serve with crusty bread.

title: Vichyssoise
instructions: Sauté leeks and onion in butter.
Add potato and stock.
Simmer until potato is soft.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in cream, season and chill. Serve cold.

title: Miso Glazed Salmon
instructions: Mix miso, mirin, soy sauce and sugar.
Coat salmon in glaze, marinate 30 minutes.
Grill skin side up for 8 minutes.
Flip and grill 3 more minutes.
Serve with steamed rice and edamame.

title: Katsu Curry
instructions: Pound chicken flat, coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Deep fry until golden.
Make curry sauce with onion, apple, curry powder.
Serve sliced chicken over rice with curry sauce.

title: Yakitori
instructions: Cut chicken thighs into chunks.
Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar for tare.
Thread chicken on skewers.
Grill over charcoal or gas, basting with tare.
Serve with shichimi togarashi.

title: Tom Yum Soup
instructions: Bring stock to boil with lemongrass and galangal.
Add mushrooms and shrimp.
Season with fish sauce, lime juice and chilli.
Add coconut milk if desired.
Garnish with coriander and serve.

title: Massaman Curry
instructions: Fry Massaman curry paste in oil.
Add chicken and coat well.
Add coconut milk, potato and peanuts.
Simmer 40 minutes.
Season with fish sauce, sugar and tamarind.

title: Bulgur Pilaf
instructions: Sauté onion in olive oil.
Add tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Add bulgur wheat and stock.
Simmer covered 15 minutes.
Fluff with fork and serve with salad.

title: Iskender Kebab
instructions: Grill thinly sliced lamb until crispy.
Make tomato butter sauce.
Toast pieces of flatbread.
Layer bread, lamb, yogurt and tomato sauce.
Top with browned butter.

title: Baklava
instructions: Layer filo pastry with melted butter.
Spread ground walnuts or pistachios between layers.
Cut into diamond shapes before baking.
Bake at 180°C for 45 minutes.
Pour cold honey syrup over hot baklava.

title: Pork Belly
instructions: Score pork skin deeply.
Rub with salt, pepper and fennel seeds.
Roast at 220°C for 30 min for crackling.
Reduce to 160°C and roast 2 more hours.
Rest before slicing.

title: Toad in the Hole
instructions: Make Yorkshire pudding batter with flour, eggs and milk.
Heat oil in roasting tin until smoking.
Add sausages to tin and cook 10 minutes.
Pour batter over sausages.
Bake at 220°C for 30 minutes without opening oven.

title: Ceviche
instructions: Cut fresh white fish into small cubes.
Marinate in lime juice for 15-20 minutes.
Add diced onion, chilli, coriander.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve with plantain chips.

title: Beef Empanadas
instructions: Make pastry dough and rest 30 minutes.
Cook beef filling with onion, olives, cumin.
Fill pastry circles and crimp edges.
Brush with egg wash.
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes.

title: Jerk Chicken
instructions: Blend scotch bonnet, allspice, thyme, garlic, ginger.
Marinate chicken overnight.
Grill on low heat for 45 minutes.
Turn and baste frequently.
Serve with rice and peas and plantain.

title: Poutine
instructions: Fry potato chips until golden.
Make rich beef gravy.
Place chips in bowl.
Top with cheese curds.
Pour hot gravy over and serve immediately.

title: Butter Tarts
instructions: Make shortcrust pastry and line muffin tin.
Mix butter, sugar, eggs, syrup and vanilla.
Add raisins if desired.
Fill pastry cases.
Bake at 190°C for 18-20 minutes.

title: Kimchi Fried Rice
instructions: Fry kimchi in sesame oil until slightly caramelised.
Add cold cooked rice and stir fry.
Make space in pan and fry egg.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Top with spring onion and sesame seeds.

title: Bibimbap
instructions: Cook rice.
Prepare vegetables: blanch spinach, sauté mushrooms, julienne carrot.
Cook beef with soy sauce and garlic.
Arrange everything in bowl over rice.
Top with fried egg and gochujang.

title: Laksa
instructions: Fry laksa paste until fragrant.
Add chicken stock and coconut milk.
Add shrimp, tofu and fish balls.
Cook noodles separately.
Serve noodles in soup with toppings.

title: Nasi Goreng
instructions: Fry shallots and garlic in oil.
Add chicken and stir fry.
Add cold rice and mix well.
Season with kecap manis, soy sauce, sambal.
Top with fried egg and prawn crackers.

title: Gado Gado
instructions: Boil eggs, potato and green beans.
Make peanut sauce with peanut butter, lime, soy.
Arrange vegetables, tofu, eggs.
Pour peanut sauce over.
Serve with prawn crackers.

title: Pho Bo
instructions: Simmer beef bones for 3 hours with spices.
Strain clear broth.
Season with fish sauce and salt.
Cook rice noodles separately.
Serve with raw beef, herbs, lime and chilli.

title: Banh Mi
instructions: Marinate pork with lemongrass, fish sauce, sugar.
Grill until caramelised.
Split baguette and spread mayo.
Fill with pork, pickled veg, coriander, chilli.
Serve immediately.

title: Beef Kafta
instructions: Mix ground beef with onion, parsley, cumin, paprika.
Shape into ovals around skewers.
Grill or pan fry until cooked through.
Serve with flatbread, salad and tahini.

title: Tabbouleh
instructions: Soak bulgur wheat in water 30 minutes.
Finely chop parsley, mint, tomatoes, cucumber.
Mix with bulgur, lemon juice and olive oil.
Season and refrigerate.
Serve with flatbread.

title: Chicken Shawarma
instructions: Marinate chicken with cumin, turmeric, garlic, lemon.
Grill until cooked and slightly charred.
Warm flatbreads.
Slice chicken and fill wraps with salad, tahini.
Add pickles and serve.

title: Spinach and Ricotta Cannelloni
instructions: Mix ricotta with spinach, egg and nutmeg.
Fill cannelloni tubes with mixture.
Place in baking dish with tomato sauce.
Cover with béchamel and cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 35 minutes.

title: Clam Chowder
instructions: Fry bacon until crispy, set aside.
Sauté onion and celery in butter.
Add flour to make roux.
Add clam juice, potato and cream.
Simmer until potato is soft, add clams.

title: Lobster Bisque
instructions: Sauté vegetables with tomato paste.
Add brandy and flambé.
Add fish stock and cream.
Simmer and blend until smooth.
Add lobster meat and serve with crusty bread.

title: Shakshuka with Feta
instructions: Sauté onion and peppers with garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Crumble feta over sauce.
Make wells and add eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs are just set.

title: Momos
instructions: Make dough with flour and water.
Mix chicken or veg filling with ginger, garlic, coriander.
Fill and pleat dumplings.
Steam for 15 minutes.
Serve with spicy tomato chutney.

title: Okonomiyaki
instructions: Mix batter with flour, eggs, dashi, cabbage.
Add pork belly slices on top.
Cook in oiled pan 5 minutes each side.
Top with mayo, okonomiyaki sauce.
Garnish with bonito flakes.

title: Chana Masala
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic and ginger.
Add tomatoes and cook until mushy.
Add spices: cumin, coriander, garam masala.
Add chickpeas and simmer 20 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and lemon.

title: Mutton Rogan Josh
instructions: Brown lamb in ghee.
Add whole spices and onion.
Add yogurt gradually and cook.
Add tomatoes and red chilli.
Slow cook 1 hour until tender.

title: Baba Ganoush
instructions: Char eggplant directly over flame until black.
Cool and scoop out flesh.
Blend with tahini, lemon, garlic, olive oil.
Season with salt and cumin.
Serve with pita and paprika.

title: Corn Chowder
instructions: Sauté onion and celery in butter.
Add potato and corn.
Pour in stock and simmer 20 minutes.
Blend half the soup for creaminess.
Add cream, season and serve with crackers.

title: Greek Moussaka
instructions: Fry eggplant slices.
Make lamb ragù with tomatoes and spices.
Make béchamel sauce.
Layer eggplant, lamb, béchamel.
Bake at 180°C for 45 minutes until golden.

title: Spanakopita
instructions: Mix spinach with feta, eggs and dill.
Layer filo pastry with butter in tin.
Add spinach filling.
Top with remaining filo and butter.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes.

title: Beef Kofta
instructions: Mix ground beef with onion, parsley, cumin, paprika.
Roll into sausage shapes.
Grill on high heat turning often.
Serve with flatbread, salad and yogurt.

title: Kedgeree
instructions: Poach smoked haddock in milk.
Cook basmati rice with turmeric.
Flake fish and mix with rice.
Add hard boiled eggs and cream.
Season and garnish with parsley.

title: Roasted Vegetable Tart
instructions: Blind bake shortcrust pastry case.
Roast vegetables with olive oil and herbs.
Make egg and cream custard filling.
Fill pastry with vegetables and custard.
Bake at 160°C for 35 minutes until set.
